glosses: Tuesday (the third day of the week in many religious traditions, and the second day of the week in systems that use the ISO 8601 norm; it follows Monday and precedes Wednesday)

examples.text: Entonces también puedes esperar hasta el martes.
examples.en: You might as well wait until Tuesday.

examples.text: El próximo lunes y martes son fiesta.
examples.en: Next Monday and Tuesday are holidays.

examples.text: Recuérdame que la reunión es el martes.
examples.en: Remind me that the meeting is on Monday.

examples.text: Debo terminar este trabajo para el próximo martes.
examples.en: I must get this work finished by next Tuesday.
